#112 Re #99

In the KU-example above, for the particle on the boundary of the 2d PCS theory, the role of AAA is played by tensoring with the prequantum line bundle of the boundary theory. Traditional geometric quantization is recovered here in the form that “the Hilbert space of quantum states of the particle is the 2-expectation value of its prequantum line bundle regarded as a boundary operator of the cobounding 2d PCS theory”.

In the tmf-example above, for the string on the boundary of the 3d CS theory, the role of AAA is similarly played by tensoring with the Kalb-Ramond B-field 2-bundle.

Presumably this continues with something to do with the C-field. And what then if

the C-field is simply a cocycle in J- twisted Cohomotopy ?
subject: Type-semantics for quantization
